label: Ear tilt

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 3.1 #15 (anchor ratios sections 2/3.2, preset formula section 3.0)

range.endpoint_anchor: tilt index: 0.55 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.50 -> -100 = 0.05, +100 = 1.05 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.55) / 0.50)

region.mask_rule: ear part meshes L/R rotation about the base pivot, mirrored; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Pinna rotation: - = folded/flopped, + = pricked forward. The dog baseline's drop ear lives entirely here (-65, Labrador-type) while its size ratios stay erect-equivalent (spec section 3.3). A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
